html.agent_loop_warn_2: (enabling all tools such as file read/write and command execution). The original chat history is kept, but the interface and available tools change accordingly.
html.agent_loop_warn_3: The Loop keeps running on the backend and reuses the current permission policy and working directory; the budget counts only new prompts and model output each turn, not existing sessions or cached context. Each failed turn is retried automatically up to 2 times, and repeated identical test failures pause it. To interrupt, click "Stop" above the input box.

html.settings_general_desc: Manage model context, notifications, mobile access, and local data
html.shortcuts_hint: Shortcuts: ⌘K Search · ⌘N New Session · Esc Close
html.tip_agent_loop: • Click the loop button in the input toolbar to start Agent Loop, letting Claude iterate toward the goal until done, blocked, or the budget runs out
html.tip_checkpoint: • Git repositories are auto-checkpointed, so you can roll back to before the conversation in one click
html.tip_chrome_ext: • The Chrome extension can open the Side Panel from its icon, and can read the full current page or ask about right-click-selected content
html.tip_drag_doc: • Drag documents (PDF / DOCX / XLSX, etc.) to upload and extract text
html.tip_magic_wand: • Click the magic wand in the input toolbar to optimize the current prompt using golden samples and personal rules
html.tip_mobile: • For mobile access use the same WiFi + a specified local IP + an access code; the phone is a Q&A mode where you can ask, view results, and switch saved projects, while management is done on the local desktop
html.tip_mobile_drawer: • On mobile the left session list is a drawer; tapping the overlay / close button / selecting a session collapses it, and the bottom input area is adapted to the iPhone safe area
html.tip_narrow_screen: • On narrow screens code blocks, tool results, and edit diffs scroll horizontally or stack vertically to keep long code from stretching the page
html.tip_paste_image: • Paste an image to send it directly (screenshots supported)
html.tip_paste_url: • Paste a URL to automatically fetch the page body as context
html.tip_rename: • Double-click a session title to rename it, or click 🪄 to let AI name it
html.tip_retry: • When a tool call fails you can grant permission and retry in one click
html.tip_star: • Star ⭐ key user messages or answers, then use the "Marks" tab on the left to quickly revisit milestones in long sessions
html.tip_thumbs: • After giving an answer a 👍 or marking it, it can become a golden-sample candidate for the Prompt Optimizer
html.trusted_network_desc: Local, same-WiFi, and trusted private networks such as ZeroTier are allowed directly; only public sources reach the remote verification page.
html.upload_file: Upload file (HTML / source / document text files supported)
html.url_context_desc: Detect URLs automatically and fetch page content as context on send
html.view_stats: View stats (estimated prices, for reference only)
html.web_tools_desc: Control WebSearch / WebFetch in Code mode; even when off you can still use curl, npm, pip, and other commands via Bash.
html.workspace_presets_desc: Save project, model, mode, and verification commands
html.worktree_note: Each worktree uses a separate directory and derived Code session; deleting it does not automatically delete the Git branch
html.worktrees_desc: Create isolated Code sessions for parallel tasks
html.yolo_mode_desc: Fully automated, bypassing all permission checks [use with caution]
